muted.description: Supporting copy, versions, filters, and metadata.

accent.description: Dark-theme primary action surface, focus accent, and active-state emphasis.

accent-secondary.description: Light-theme interactive accent, dark-theme secondary gradient stop, and metadata emphasis.

body.purpose: Localized summaries and general reading text.

breakpoints.name: card-minimum
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum task-card width in the responsive grid.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action with a theme-aware yellow/green treatment; light mode uses a pale green surface with dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.7rem 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; font: 600 1rem/1 var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-on-accent, #151515); background: var(--color-accent-surface, #faff69); transition: transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #166534); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary, bordered button for source navigation; transparent at rest, foreground text on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.7rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 0.75rem; font: 600 1rem/1 var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-fg, #e6e8ee); transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.32); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #166534); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Pill filter control; muted at rest, theme-aware pale accent surface with dark text when active. State must not rely on color alone.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, #9aa3b2); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; transition: color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--color-fg, #e6e8ee); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #166534); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-chip--active { background: var(--color-accent-surface, #bbf7d0); color: var(--color-on-accent, #151515); border-color: var(--color-accent-surface, #bbf7d0); }

components.name: Tag Pill
components.description: Compact metadata tag inside task cards; small accent pill supporting fast scanning.
components.css: .ds-tag { font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent-soft, rgba(22,101,52,.1)); color: var(--color-accent, #166534); }

components.name: Task Card
components.description: Frosted translucent result card with border-led separation; border shifts toward the accent and the card lifts 2px on hover.
components.css: .ds-task-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 1rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); transition: border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-task-card:hover { border-color: rgba(109,139,255,0.5); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-task-card:focus-within { border-color: rgba(109,139,255,0.5); } .ds-task-card__title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--color-fg, #e6e8ee); } .ds-task-card__version { align-self: flex-start; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--color-muted, #9aa3b2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Flexible frosted search input with a Soft Divider border and the visible 2px theme accent focus outline.
components.html: <input type="search" class="ds-search" placeholder="Search tasks..." aria-label="Search tasks" />
components.css: .ds-search { flex: 1 1 220px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: var(--color-fg, #e6e8ee); font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, #9aa3b2); } .ds-search:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #166534); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Locale Toggle
components.description: Grouped bordered language switch (EN / 中文); muted at rest, foreground text on hover/focus. Must preserve EN/ZH structural parity.
components.css: .ds-locale { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 0.75rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-locale__btn { background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, #9aa3b2); border: none; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-locale__btn:hover, .ds-locale__btn:focus-visible { color: var(--color-fg, #e6e8ee); } .ds-locale__btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #6d8bff); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: A focused bilingual catalog for reusable HagiCode workflows. A nearly black dark theme and quiet light theme keep task metadata easy to scan, while yellow and green identify the small set of active and actionable states.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow and green reserved for active states and primary actions.
Subtle translucent cards separated by borders instead of shadows.
Compact compatibility metadata and tag treatment.
Bilingual English and Simplified Chinese content with shared structure.

rules.name: The Accent-Is-Action Rule
rules.body: Use yellow or green for actionable, active, or focused states; accent without a state or action is visual noise.

rules.name: The Surface-Stays-Quiet Rule
rules.body: Cards use subtle white transparency and borders rather than opaque gray panels, gradients, or stacked shadows.

rules.name: The Locale-Parity Rule
rules.body: Every visible English label that participates in content hierarchy has an equivalent Chinese label in the same component structure.

rules.name: The Hover-Moves-a-Little Rule
rules.body: Interactive task cards may lift by 2px over 150ms; controls communicate state through color, border, or underline before motion.

rules.name: The Focus-Is-Visible Rule
rules.body: Search fields use a 2px theme accent outline with 1px offset. New interactive components must provide an equally visible keyboard focus treatment.

dos: Keep content inside the 1080px page width and preserve the hero-to-toolbar-to-grid reading order.
Use the theme-aware accent tokens for focus, active filters, primary actions, and interactive text.
Preserve bilingual content pairs using the existing locale visibility classes.
Provide a visible focus style and explicit empty state for filterable collections.
donts: Do not replace Console Black (#0B0D12) with bright white or mid-gray page surfaces.
Do not spread accent gradients across cards, metadata, or body-copy areas.
Do not add persistent shadows, glassmorphism blur, glowing particles, or neon AI-tool styling.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate selected filters, focus state, or locale.
Do not introduce components that break English and Simplified Chinese structural parity.
